summary: Iter128 — Verified Super Admin acting-org bug fix (Login.jsx setActingOrg('', false); Layout.jsx validActing re-sync). Backend invariants + full E2E repro on preview https://manage-events-12.preview.emergentagent.com. All 6 scenarios pass. The reported bug (dashboard 'Impossibile caricare le attività' because /api/my/todo returns 428 with X-Org-Id missing after SPA re-login) no longer reproduces.
critical_code_review_comments: Login.jsx:34 — email/password submit now calls setActingOrg('', false) BEFORE login POST. This clears both localStorage AND React state actingOrgId synchronously (AuthContext setActingOrg with id='' removes key and sets state to ''). Correct.

Layout.jsx:258-279 — Super Admin effect loads /platform/organizations and resolves target = stored∈ids ? stored : actingOrgId∈ids ? actingOrgId : last_org:<uid>∈ids ? last : data[0].id. Then calls setActingOrg(target,false,stored||'') ONLY if target differs. This fixes the stale-state case AND the invalid-stored case.
Layout.jsx:281 validActing = orgs has id AND localStorage===state. Correct dual-source invariant; gate (gateForOrg) prevents main content render until both match.
AuthContext.js:12-20 setActingOrg: synchronously writes localStorage then setState, matching api.js interceptor source-of-truth. OK.
api.js:13-17 X-Org-Id interceptor reads localStorage every request. Compatible with Layout's always-write pattern. OK.
Backend _resolve_active_org: SA without X-Org-Id → 428 (verified live); SA with invalid id → 404; non-SA with other org id → 403. All security invariants intact.

rca of the issue: RCA (per main agent, verified fixed): Pre-fix Login.jsx removed localStorage['acting_org_id'] but left AuthContext state actingOrgId pointing to the stale id, then nav('/app') via SPA (no full reload). On /app, Layout read state.actingOrgId → non-empty → showed super-acting-banner and did NOT gate; however axios interceptor reads localStorage (now empty) → every /api/* call lacked X-Org-Id → backend 428 → TodoPanel showed 'Impossibile caricare'. FIX: Login submit now calls setActingOrg('', false) which synchronously nukes both state AND localStorage before login POST; AFTER login, Layout's SA effect loads /platform/organizations and reconciles target from (stored|state|last_org|first), then calls setActingOrg(target, false, previous) to realign both sources. Gate condition validActing requires localStorage===state AND id ∈ orgs, so no main render happens with mismatched sources. End-to-end live preview test confirms X-Org-Id is now sent (verified in Playwright request headers) and /api/my/todo returns 200 instead of 428.
